resources.name: providers
resources.title: Providers
resources.description: Each provider's own public pages, read by ComputeFinder. Link-out only. 84 records; checked through 2026-10-23.

resources.name: countries
resources.title: Countries and territories
resources.description: Government, regulator, grid and trade press pages. Reported items are labelled as the source gives them. 111 records; checked through 2026-10-03.

resources.name: policy
resources.title: Policy register
resources.description: Primary legal and government sources, one record per jurisdiction with its instruments. 17 records; checked through 2026-10-02.

resources.name: supply-chain
resources.title: Supply chain
resources.description: Company and technology pages, plus trade press where a constraint is marked reported. 118 records; checked through 2026-10-14.

resources.name: programmes
resources.title: Free and funded compute programmes
resources.description: Each programme's own page. 52 records; checked through 2026-10-17.

resources.name: news
resources.title: News
resources.description: Source-linked news accounts labelled official, corroborated or source claim, plus separately labelled editorial corrections and explicitly scoped source guides. A source guide supplies reading routes rather than a verified account of every linked announcement. An editorial correction is not a newly verified source account; archive and correction dates remain distinct. page_url links the exact ComputeFinder account; source_url remains the original evidence. 77 records; checked through 2026-11-04.

resources.name: export-controls
resources.title: Export controls and compute thresholds
resources.description: Official gazettes and regulator texts. Information only, not legal advice. 23 records; checked through 2026-10-03.

resources.name: grid-rules
resources.title: Grid rules for large loads
resources.description: Grid operator, regulator and government pages, summarised in our own words. Each record links its source. 11 records; checked through 2026-10-31.

resources.name: grid-demand-evidence
resources.title: Large-load demand evidence
resources.description: Two scoped operator statements distinguish forecast adjustments from a load queue and overlapping reservation/ordinary-queue categories. No demand-capacity total, project list or connection guarantee is supplied. 2 records; checked through 2026-10-31.

resources.name: data-centre-records
resources.title: Data centre records
resources.description: Operator, planning and regulator pages, plus explicitly attributed publisher records. Source-reported identity is not a verified operating stage. Capacity is per metric, stage and basis and is never to be summed. 100 records; checked through 2026-10-21.

resources.name: research
resources.title: Research in context
resources.description: Original attributed accounts of research, methods and guidance with scope, uncertainty, reuse terms and source-specific exclusions. Guidance is not an empirical finding or modelled result by itself. No underlying dataset, Annex, chart, proprietary input or local-project inference is imported. 7 records; checked through 2026-10-31.

resources.name: claim-reviews
resources.title: Claim reviews
resources.description: Scoped editorial reviews with exact claim, attribution, typed citations, methods, finding, reason and unresolved questions. Empty evidence lists mean no evidence recorded, not none exists. 4 records; checked through 2026-11-06.

resources.name: site-record-links
resources.title: Named-campus record links
resources.description: One precisely reviewed same-named-campus contextual inference between retained publisher and detailed records. It does not identify a shared building, phase, parcel, owner/user, metric, operation or coordinate, and does not deduplicate source records. 1 records; checked through 2026-11-01.

resources.name: evidence-samples
resources.title: Unscored usefulness evidence samples
resources.description: Dated scoped original-source and repository observations for Trust, Evidence depth and Freshness. The remaining seven dimensions are unassessed; counts do not calibrate a score or establish visitor benefit. 3 records; checked through 2026-10-31.

resources.name: lifecycle-evidence
resources.title: Repair, reuse and retirement evidence
resources.description: Three reviewed source scopes distinguish historical technical guidance, an issued named grid-asset licence condition and an operator-reported named-system retirement. The retirement report does not establish disposal, recovery or site closure/restoration; the older records are not promoted to completed outcomes. 3 records; checked through 2026-11-01.

resources.name: services
resources.title: Selected commercial service scopes
resources.description: Three selected provider-attributed categories: AWS migration staffing guidance, Canonical physical-server provisioning/support and Salute commissioning. Separate from the existing programme routes; not a representative services census, ranking or endorsement. 3 records; checked through 2026-10-31.

resources.name: standards-evidence
resources.title: Scoped national standards catalogue evidence
resources.description: One reviewed DIN German Part1 catalogue record, not all standards, normative clauses, every national edition or facility conformity. The same canonical object drives the scoped EN50600 entry. 1 records; checked through 2026-10-31.

resources.name: frontier-data-centres
resources.title: Frontier AI data centres
resources.description: Reduced fields from Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers, under Epoch AI's CC BY 4.0 notice.
